title: USACE Nashville District - Rescued Fisherman Speaks
description: David Davis, a resident of Greenbrier, Tenn., fought for his life when his boat capsized in the turbine discharge area below Cheatham Dam June 26, 2010.  During an interview Nov. 27, 2012 he shared his unique perspective of what it is like to be sucked to the bottom of the Cumberland River.  He volunteered to give his testimony in hopes of saving others that put their lives at risk every time they fish in the hazardous waters below hydroelectric dams. Produced by Leon Roberts.
